title: QBIND Public DevNet Machine-Readable Anchor Drift Report
description: Canonical, publish-safe schema for the MACHINE-READABLE anchor-drift report of the QBIND public DevNet release package under docs/release/public-devnet. It is the JSON counterpart of the human-readable ANCHOR_DRIFT_REPORT.md (Run 406): both compare the Run 404 curated ANCHOR manifest (PACKAGE_INTEGRITY_MANIFEST.example.json) against the Run 405/406 FULL-TREE generated file set. The report is GENERATED TRANSIENTLY at verification time into a staging directory OUTSIDE the package tree and is NOT committed (the tree changes over time, so a committed drift report would immediately drift). Docs/artifact only: it embeds NO binary blob, NO secret, NO private path/hostname/endpoint, NO raw log, NO raw /metrics dump, and NO generated private identity. Retention of this report as a download-only CI artifact is convenience/audit usability only; it is NOT a signed attestation, NOT binary provenance, and NOT launch evidence. It moves NO readiness item: M4 stays Yellow, M6 stays Yellow/Partial, S5/S7 stay Yellow, public DevNet stays NOT launch-ready, and C4/C5 stay OPEN.

report_version.description: Report schema version (semver of this schema contract).

generated_for_run.description: The QBIND run number this machine-readable drift report was introduced for. Fixed to 407.

scope.description: Stable scope tag for this report. Curated anchor set vs. full documentation-package tree drift only.

package_root.description: Repository-relative root of the documented public DevNet package. All relative_path values are resolved against this root. Never an absolute path.

anchor_manifest_path.description: Repository-relative path (resolved under package_root) of the Run 404 curated anchor manifest this report was compared against.

full_tree_manifest_artifact_name.description: Leaf name of the download-only full-tree manifest CI artifact this report was compared against.

generated_at_utc.description: OPTIONAL UTC timestamp (ISO-8601, Zulu) when this report was generated. Informational only.

safety_labels.description: Standing safety labels this report carries. All required labels must be present.

counts.description: Integer counts. Each must equal the length of the correspondingly-named array, and must agree with the Markdown ANCHOR_DRIFT_REPORT.md summary counts.

anchors_present_matching.description: Curated anchor entries whose sha256 + byte_size equal the full-tree entry for the same path (unchanged).

anchors_missing.description: Curated anchor entries whose path is absent from the full-tree set. Always a failure; must be empty for a POSITIVE report.

undocumented_mismatches.description: Curated anchor entries whose sha256/byte_size differ from the full tree WITHOUT a documented deliberate refresh. Always a failure; must be empty for a POSITIVE report.

documented_refreshes.description: Curated anchor entries whose hash/size were deliberately refreshed and documented in the same run.

full_tree_only.description: Full-tree files not represented in the curated anchor set. Expected curated-anchor drift, not a failure.

non_claims.description: Explicit non-claim booleans. Every field must be exactly false (this report makes none of these claims).

artifact_safety_label.description: Standing human-readable safety label this report carries.
artifact_safety_label.const: experimental · resettable · no value · no uptime SLA · NOT public-DevNet launch-ready · no MainNet readiness claim · no C4/C5 closure claim
